description: Header file defining a specialized lock-free multi-producer multi-consumer concurrent queue using MoodyCamel's concurrentqueue library, with support for non-blocking and sleeping wait policies, including consumer classes and queue management functions.

classes.name: concurrent_queue
classes.description: Template class implementing a lock-free MPMC queue with non-blocking and optional sleeping wait policies, wrapping MoodyCamel's concurrentqueue.

classes.name: concurrent_queue::consumer_type
classes.description: Nested class providing a consumer interface for the queue, with try_pop and bulk operations.

methods.name: concurrent_queue
methods.description: Constructor initializing the queue with specified size and number of pre-reserved producers.

methods.name: create_consumer
methods.description: Creates and returns a consumer object for the queue.

methods.name: try_push
methods.description: Attempts to enqueue an element into the queue.

methods.name: try_push_bulk
methods.description: Attempts to enqueue a bulk of elements into the queue.

methods.name: push_blocking
methods.description: Enqueues an element in a blocking manner.

methods.name: try_pop
methods.description: Attempts to dequeue an element from the queue.

methods.name: try_pop_bulk
methods.description: Attempts to dequeue a bulk of elements.

methods.name: size
methods.description: Returns an approximate size of the queue.

methods.name: empty
methods.description: Checks if the queue is empty.

methods.name: capacity
methods.description: Returns the maximum capacity of the queue.
